_comment: Named cluster shapes, each holding every answer the pg_deploy_cluster.sh wizard asks for. Deploy one with: ./pg_deploy_cluster.sh --topology 3-node. List them with --list-topologies.
_machines: A topology describes the shape, not the machines. Which hosts it lands on comes from configuration/inventory.json, so the same topology can be deployed to any host set. One Spock node per host; surplus nodes share hosts on ports base_port+1, +2, ...
_precedence: A flag on the command line beats the topology, which beats inventory defaults, which beats the built-in defaults. So --topology 3-node --pg-major 18 deploys the 3-node shape on PostgreSQL 18.
_keys: Key names match configuration/inventory.json's defaults block and the fields of ClusterPlan, so there is one vocabulary across all three. Every key below is optional; omit one and the inventory default applies.

2-node.description: The smallest multi-master cluster: two Spock peers, each accepting writes and replicating to the other. No standby, so a lost node stays down until it is fixed while the other keeps serving.

3-node.description: Three Spock peers. Three hosts also make a fault-tolerant etcd: a two-host cluster loses its DCS with either machine, while three survive one. Still no standby — a failed node's data stays on that node until it returns.

_field_notes.deploy_mode: packages | source. A source build needs an exact pg_version and compiles on every host, 20-40 minutes each.
_field_notes.repo_channel: release | staging | daily. Packages mode only.
_field_notes.node_count: Spock nodes: multi-master peers, each leading a Patroni scope of its own.
_field_notes.standby_of: Spock nodes that get a Patroni standby, as names: ["n1", "n2"]. A standby is a physical replica of that node alone, which Patroni can promote. It never holds a peer's data.
_field_notes.pg_version: An exact version such as 17.11, or 19.0beta3. Required for a source build; for packages, empty means whatever the channel carries.
_field_notes.spock_branch: Source mode only: the git branch or tag to build. Empty means the default for the Spock major (v5_STABLE for spock50, main for spock60).
_field_notes.synchronous_mode: off | on | quorum, per scope. Only meaningful where standby_of gives that scope a standby to wait for.
_field_notes.synchronous_mode_strict: With a synchronous mode, block writes when no standby is available rather than silently falling back to asynchronous.
_field_notes.pg_extensions: none, or a comma-separated list: pgedge-lolor, pgedge-snowflake, pgedge-ace. Each entry may say how it arrives and what to build, as name:mode[@ref].
